title: Zero-TVM: browser LLM inference on hand-written WGSL kernels
description: Browser LLM inference on hand-written WGSL kernels — models from a 3.8B dense to a 35B sparse MoE, no TVM, no WebLLM runtime, no compiler. Measured against WebLLM on identical weights; every number in BENCH.md.
notes: Live demo: https://zerotvm.com — Source and methodology: https://github.com/abgnydn/zero-tvm
